meta.parties: In Re the Last Will of Tissera Appuhamy Tissera Et Al. v. Gunatilleka Hamine

rules.statement: An application for the recall of probate cannot be made in a summary manner unless authorized by section 536, and must be brought as an action with proof of the case.
rules.supporting_quote: The person attacking the will must bring an action for the purpose in the ordinary manner, and must prove his case. Our Legislature has not adopted the English practice of proof in common form and in solemn form. The direction in section 537 that all applications for recall of probate shall be made in a particular way applies only to the applications which are authorized by section 536.
